nuggets.text: Jayden Maiava has thrown just six incompletions through the Trojans' first two games.
Kennedy Urlacher, son of Bears linebacker Brian Urlacher, had two sacks in the Trojans' 39-0 win over Fresno State.
Gary Patterson, who won 181 games as TCU's head coach, joined the Trojans as defensive coordinator in 2026.
Lincoln Riley was a walk-on quarterback at Texas Tech, backing up future Red Raiders coach Kliff Kingsbury.
The Coliseum will become the first stadium to host the Summer Olympics three times when the Games return in 2028.
Jayden Maiava's great-grandfather was pro wrestler Neff Maiava, and his uncle Kaluka played linebacker at USC.
The Trojans are the only FBS team that has never played an FCS opponent since the 1978 split.
Traveler debuted in 1961, and the first rider wore the costume Charlton Heston wore in Ben-Hur.
Freshman Trent Mosley caught seven passes for 118 yards and a touchdown in his Trojans debut.
On Sept. 12, 1970, the Trojans became the first fully integrated team to play in Alabama, 56 years ago today.
